people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Taanach
people.line: Canaanite city allotted to Manasseh, later a Levitical city

translations.web: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.
translations.bsb: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Taanach and Gath-rimmon—two cities, together with their pasturelands.
translations.kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
translations.asv: And out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with its suburbs; two cities.
